notes.title: New big game update
notes.content: We've made major optimizations to the game, fixing reported bugs and making a few tweaks to improve the game.

notes.title: New game mode
notes.content:
We have prepared a new game mode that opens up new gameplay possibilities. At the beginning you get a large amount of money. Build your own fauna and try out the relationships between dinosaurs. Maintain the balance of your ecosystem.

The patch also brings many minor fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Big patch released!
notes.content:
We've optimized the economics of the game. Dinosaur prices are now more balanced to missions. 

At the same time, a big patch has been released with a lot of changes to the game. We also adjusted the camera options in economy mode.

Enjoy playing!

notes.content:
